core_message: In September 2026 SIP assets fell 4.1%, yet monthly SIP contributions still rose 0.6%.

beats.text: In September, SIP assets fell. Did SIP contributions fall too?
beats.visual_note: Cover slide: the question only, no figures

beats.text: SIP assets fell 4.1% in September 2026, to ₹17.86 lakh crore.
AMFI attributes the fall mainly to mark-to-market (MTM) losses.
Monthly SIP contributions rose 0.6% in September 2026, to ₹32,490 crore.

beats.visual_note: Simple August to September comparison, no extra figures

beats.text: Contributing SIP accounts rose to 10.06 crore in September 2026.
In August 2026, contributing SIP accounts stood at 10.02 crore.
